question: Can the typed HSWM cell kernel survive the named SQLite commit, crash, duplicate, conflict, and effect-uncertainty cases while completing one injected cell adapter path?
scope: Engineering protective-belt test only; no larger-AI, semantic-learning, transfer, topology, or consolidation verdict.
kill_conditions: Any required fault gate is false.
An external cell invocation can occur before its request event and outbox intent are committed.
An expired in-flight effect is automatically retried without reconciliation.
An exact command retry appends a second event or creates a second effect.
The same idempotency key with different intent is accepted.
The implementation claims exactly-once external model execution.
implementation_constraints: Use only the Python standard library for SQLite persistence and HTTP transport.
Keep model calls outside decide, evolve, replay, and the SQLite transaction.
Use BEGIN IMMEDIATE and a monotone stream version for the single-writer commit boundary.
Treat unknown external outcomes as suspended reconciliation, not retryable success.
Keep all existing F1-F5 experiment files and receipts outside the write set.
